summary: The game moves to new engines: Pixi.js for the picture and Tone.js for the sound. There is a new dungeon screen, an opening story and a balance pass. This list covers v0.4.1, v0.4.2 and v0.5.

highlights.title: New engines
highlights.text: Pixi.js draws the town, the battle and the castle. Tone.js plays the music.

highlights.title: Dungeon screen
highlights.text: See the dungeon, its monsters and your heroes, and start the fight, all in one view.

highlights.title: Spell trees
highlights.text: All 7 classes follow one blueprint: 6 spell families with ranks and an Ultimate at level 20.

groups.heading: Spells and battle rules
items: Each class has 6 spell families with ranks and one Ultimate at level 20.
New statuses: Evade, Burn, Hex and Empower. Dodge, absorb and burn show on the stage, the health bar and the combat log.
Each class has its own damage swing. A hit can never lose more than 85% of its damage to Defence.

groups.heading: Opening story
items: A new player picks a language and sees a story of 5 pictures. The game asks about a new bracket when one starts.

groups.heading: Balance
items: Kills needed per level in the best dungeon are now 1.9, 2.9, 2.9, 2.9, 3.9, 4.9, 4.9, 5.4, 5.4 and 6.9. A level-up keeps the extra XP.
The Goblin Chief attack is 7.7, and the Hobgoblin is 10% stronger.
Level 1 monsters always drop each basic material.
Crafter XP follows the number of main materials. Craft time follows the ingredient count.

groups.heading: New screens
items: A new dungeon screen with the dungeon picture, the monsters, the hero picker and the Fight button.
A new monster detail window and a stack of toast messages.
A level-up window shows the gains of each class.
A summary window shows the new item when a crafter finishes.
The Leatherworking crafter has its own workshop section.
The recipe filter is saved for each crafter.

groups.heading: Sound and art
items: New castle music: a slow march in D major. The town plays the music of the oldest active run.
New hero art for all 7 classes.

sections.title: Known issues
sections.intro: These problems are known and are not fixed in this version.

groups.heading: Game
items: The balance scenarios did not run for this version, so the numbers are not checked.
The new pictures and sounds are not checked by eye and ear yet.
